title: Surprise-Based Teddy Bear
summary: Exploding teddy bear deals Fire damage and knockback.

fields.Throw: Action, 60 ft range. Explodes after a brief impact delay. When placed it remains inert unless destroyed. 5 HP. Fire damage alone does not detonate it without destroying it.
fields.Blast: 13 ft radius, 6d6 Fire, DC 15 Dexterity save halves damage. Creatures are knocked back 7 ft without a save. The bear itself is the damage source.
fields.Acquisition: Three in locked trapped crate in Requisitioned Barn at (83, −108). No Alchemy recipe.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
